headline: Canadian frac weakness offset by U.S. mine gate growth
summary_short: Q2 2026 revenue CAD 137.1M (-32% y/y) on 24% sand volume decline in WCSB from low nat gas prices. U.S. mine gate + Sahara ramp offset partially. Net loss improved CAD 19.2M.
summary_long: Source Energy posted Q2 2026 total revenue of CAD 137.1M, -32% y/y, driven by lower activity in the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin as low natural gas prices pushed customers to moderate frac spending. Sand sales volume 831,234 MT (-24% y/y). Adjusted EBITDA CAD 18.5M vs CAD 35.2M in Q2 2025. Adjusted gross margin CAD 29.8M. Bright spot: U.S. mine-gate sales surged, offsetting some Canadian weakness. Sahara integrated logistics fleet utilization 60% overall, 100% in the US market. Net loss CAD 5.6M vs Q2 2025 net loss CAD 24.8M (CAD 19.2M improvement).
confidence_notes: Company is CAD-reporting Canadian frac sand producer, exposed to WCSB gas activity cycle. U.S. exposure via mine gate + Sahara is smaller but growing (100% utilization in US suggests capacity add potential). LNG-linked demand recovery mentioned in the earnings deck as a forward tailwind.
